Saint Paul College was established in 1910, and we are proud to be honoring more than 108 years of education​​​. 

Saint Paul College was ranked the #1 com​munity college in the nation in 2010 and 2013 by Washington Monthly magazine, for student engagement in active and collaborative learning, student-faculty interaction and support for learning. ​The College offers 54 associate degree programs, including the Associate of Arts degree, 77 career certificate, and diploma programs. Since our humble beginning, we have been helping students succeed in high-demand careers!
